fields.label: Title
fields.value: Review a PoW network's security budget

fields.label: Scenario
fields.value: A protocol team wants to understand whether miner incentives remain sufficient as subsidy changes.

fields.label: Steps
value: Track block subsidy and transaction fees over time.
Estimate network hash rate and concentration among pools or operators.
Assess hardware and energy costs and the availability of rentable hash power.
Compare plausible attack resources with the network's protection and economic exposure.
Repeat after halvings or material market changes.

fields.label: Outcome
fields.value: The team has a structured threat and economic review; numerical estimates must use current, independently verified data.

value: Build a candidate block template from candidate transactions and metadata.
